Fetch MMA fight center data from ESPN's unofficial API

Source: R/fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter.R
fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter.Rd

Retrieves detailed fight card information from ESPN's MMA Fight Center, including main card and preliminary fights with fighter details, records, and fight information.

Usage

fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter(
  event_id = NULL,
  league = "ufc",
  include_prelims = TRUE,
  timeout = 30,
  raw = FALSE
)

Arguments

event_id

Character or Numeric. Specific event ID to fetch. If NULL, fetches the current featured fight center event (default: NULL).

league

Character. MMA league/promotion. Options: "ufc", "bellator", "pfl", "one", "rizin", or NULL for any league (default: "ufc").

include_prelims

Logical. Whether to include preliminary fights (default: TRUE).

timeout

Numeric. Request timeout in seconds (default: 30).

raw

Logical. If TRUE, assigns raw JSON to global environment (default: FALSE).

Value

Invisibly returns the data, but main purpose is global environment assignment.

Details

This function fetches detailed fight card information from ESPN's MMA Fight Center. It provides comprehensive data about individual fights including:

  • Fighter information (names, records, stats)

  • Fight details (weight class, position on card)

  • Event information (name, date, venue)

  • Card structure (main card vs prelims)

Important Notes:

  • Uses ESPN's unofficial API - may change without notice

  • Rate limiting may apply

  • Some events may not have detailed fight data available

The function assigns cleaned data to the global environment as 'mma_fights'.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get current featured fight card
fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter()
head(mma_fights)

# Get specific event by ID
fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter(event_id = "600054244")

# Get UFC fight card without prelims
fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter(league = "ufc", include_prelims = FALSE)

# Get raw JSON data
fetch_espn_mma_fightcenter(event_id = "600054244", raw = TRUE)
} # }
